annotations.title: Score what-if calls (free sandbox, no ledger write)

description: Score an unsealed set of what-if calls against 2,048 coin-flipping monkeys - free, no signing, no ledger write. Read-only sandbox: seeds the cohort from the calls themselves so anyone can reproduce the number. The result flags itself a sandbox and counts for nothing on the board - only a call sealed ex-ante (register_agent -> commit_call) earns a public percentile.

as_of.description: unix seconds as-of; defaults to server now

calls.description: 1..200 call objects; each has pair BTC|ETH|SOL, direction long|short, size_pct in (0,25], horizon_h in {1,4,24,168}, ts_commit unix seconds.
